9.4.3. qnav.gps.satellite

9.4.3.1. satellite.py

summary:

All GPS satellite and solver functionalities. This module is responsible for simulating up-to-date satellites and supplying a solver to produce measurements (with configured errors and noise). During a simulation these classes will be used for acquiring GPS information.

authors:
Dr. Niall Moroney - niall.moroney17@imperial.ac.uk
Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk
version:

0.9.0 - Awaiting further implementations.

class qnav.gps.satellite.Satellite(params: SatelliteParams, gps_time: datetime = None, pseudo_range_noise: float = 0, pseudo_range_rate_noise: float = 0, rand_seed: int = None)[source]

Represents a GPS satellite and its current states/properties. This class is responsible for representing information about a GPS satellite. Methods are supplied for updating these states and allowing for measurement information to be acquired. During simulations a collection of satellite instances will be used for generating a GPS signal that will be used to improve navigation accuracy.

update(dt: float)[source]

Updates the position, velocity and errors given the time difference. This method updates the state of the satellite by a given amount of time (in seconds). The updated position and velocity of the satellite are calculated along with the new error states for generating noisy measurements.

Parameters:

dt (float) – The time difference since the last update was requested.

get_location_azimuth_elevation(ant_pos_lla: ndarray) → tuple[float, float][source]

Get the relative location of the satellite from the current position, in azimuth and elevation (deg-deg).

Parameters:

ant_pos_lla (numpy.array (3-elements)) – The true antenna position (latitude, longitude and altitude given in deg-deg-metres).

Returns:

Returns the corresponding azimuth and elevation (both in degrees).

Return type:

tuple[float, float]

get_measurements(ant_pos_lla: ndarray, ant_att_deg: ndarray, ant_vel_body_axes: ndarray) → dict[source]

Calculates and returns the noisy pseudo ranges, position, velocity and time information for the satellite.

Parameters:

  • ant_pos_lla (numpy.array (3-elements)) – The true antenna position (latitude, longitude and altitude given in deg-deg-metres).

  • ant_att_deg (numpy.array (3-elements)) – The true antenna attitude (heading, pitch and roll in degrees).

  • ant_vel_body_axes (numpy.array (3-elements)) – The true antenna velocity (in body axes in metres/second).

Returns:

The relevant measurement information in a dict.

Return type:

dict
